questions.title: A hands-off approach
questions.prompt: The dog Jimmy was watching had a huge dingleberry, and he wouldn't let her back inside until it was gone. What was his improvised removal method?
options: Throwing snowballs at it
Getting her to sit on a sled
Leading her through a sprinkler
questions.explanation: He resorted to throwing snowballs at it. The dog hadn't even noticed the problem, but Jimmy had already developed a ranged solution.

receipts.text: Bruh the dog I’m watching has a huge dingleberry and doesn’t notice it I can’t let her inside til I somehow remove it so I’ve been throwing snowballs at it😭

questions.title: A college education finally paid off
questions.prompt: Nathan had already graduated college when he learned Berea was a town. What had he thought the word meant?
options: A special lane reserved for airport buses
An abbreviation for baggage-reclaim area
A fancy airport word for the central plaza
questions.explanation: Berea had apparently been an airport feature all along. Only after college did Nathan realize the road signs referred to a town.

receipts.text: I had graduated college before I realized Berea was the name of some town on the same interstate route as the airport and not a fancy airport word for central plaza

questions.title: The check-engine playlist
questions.prompt: Jimmy thought something was seriously wrong with his car. What turned out to be causing the alarming beeps?

A parking-assist tutorial playing on his phone
The sound effects in Migos' Open It Up
questions.explanation: The car wasn't the problem. Migos had simply put enough beeping into Open It Up to send Jimmy into diagnostic mode.

receipts.text: I thought something was seriously wrong with my car until I realized Migos just have a lot of beeping sound effects in open it up

questions.title: Nature withheld the study guide
questions.prompt: Nico's plant exams required him to identify trees by their leaves. What problem did he suddenly realize he was facing?
options: The course used trees that only grew overseas

The exam photos had all been printed in black and white
questions.explanation: “I just gotta look at the sticks and know”. Jacky asked what more they wanted from a stick; Johannes supplied the Minecraft tree catalog, and Ronan added acacia.

I just gotta look at the sticks and know
It’s all birtch, oak, dark oak and jungle wood
It’s a fucking stick what more do they want
Acacia
